subtopics.title: Discrete Mathematics
key_concepts: Sets, relations, functions, partial orders and lattices
Combinatorics, counting, recurrence relations, generating functions

subtopics.title: Linear Algebra and Calculus
key_concepts: Matrices, determinants, system of linear equations
Maxima and minima, Mean value theorem, Integration

subtopics.title: Probability and Statistics
key_concepts: Uniform, normal, exponential, Poisson and binomial distributions
Mean, median, mode and standard deviation

subtopics.title: Instruction Set and Control Unit Design
Asymptotic Analysis, Searching and Sorting
key_concepts: Asymptotic worst case time and space complexity

subtopics.title: Code Optimization and Data Flow Analysis
Data Models and Relational Query Languages
Network Basics and Data Link Layer
key_concepts: Circuit, packet, and virtual circuit switching

subtopics.title: Network Layer Protocols and Routing
key_concepts: Distance vector and link state routing

subtopics.title: Transport and Application Layers
key_concepts: TCP flow control and congestion control
